testingFeedback: Testing and review identified 8 implementation issues; all were corrected.
4 were potentially game-breaking: a build-blocking touch assignment, guest result handling, malformed initial co-op input, and guest-only developer actions.
The two-page co-op test that actually flew the wingmate exposed malformed initial input and verified results, replay, rejoining and disconnect recovery.
Headless WebGPU screenshots were least helpful because the canvas could be blank; state checks and WebGL2 captures provided useful evidence.
engineFeedback: Three.js node materials, scene graphs and native AnimationMixer clips worked well together for procedural cel-shaded assets.
I initially let render deltas drive fixed physics steps incorrectly; a fixed-step accumulator corrected the timing. Headless WebGPU screenshots were also blank despite a working renderer.
The mission state machine, assisted tow-cable mechanic, controller menus and authoritative co-op replication were custom-built.
Coordinating physics ownership, render timing and guest state without letting menu actions corrupt the shared world was the hardest integration.
A standard, concise recipe for WebGPU-safe cel shading and deterministic headless game testing would help.
promptFeedback: The source, single-file packaging and controller-first requirements give the demo a clear identity.
The 1982 source may mean the Atari game or the film era; this demo draws on the game's Hoth defense and the film's evacuation.
Making a complete three-chapter sortie, co-op, touch controls and procedural audiovisual assets work in one portable file.
Specify whether the source is the original game or the film, and provide the expected AI Hub library version inline.

aiHub.name: The Empire Strikes a Detour
aiHub.tagline: Big walkers. Small odds. One tow cable.
aiHub.description: Defend a snowbound rebel refuge in a cel-shaded arcade flight adventure. Rescue survivors, tangle siege walkers and escort the last transports through a fighter blockade, solo or with an online wingmate.
aiHub.source: Star Wars: The Empire Strikes Back (1982 video game)
aiHub.controls: WASD / left stick fly; mouse / right stick aim; click / R2 fire; Shift / L2 boost; E / Cross tow/rescue; Space / Circle roll; Escape / Options pause.
